response.what_it_is: Semi-automatic PET bottle blow molding machine (heater and blower units)
hidden_risks: Functional status of the heating lamps and electronic control panel
Condition of pneumatic cylinders, valves, and seals
Availability and wear of compatible bottle molds
Requirement for external high-pressure air compressor
response.best_proof: Video demonstration of the machine powering on, heating preforms, and successfully blowing bottles
response.failure_mode: AI might misclassify the industrial machinery as raw plastic material or a generic storage cabinet due to the boxy enclosures.
